subject: Request for short runway cushion + amendment to trial (integration blocker)
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@hydralink.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: HydraLink Integrations <integrations@hydralink.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short runway cushion — OAuth connector is blocking our rollout

Hi Rafael,

Quick note from the integrations team here — we're blocked on the OAuth exchange for the HydraLink <> Redwood connector. Our engs are digging in but it looks like the vendor we rely on for a federated token step is delaying a fix. That means our pilot timeline shifts by at least 10 business days.

We were hoping Redwood could provide a small runway cushion (extra trial credits + a two-week extension) so we can finish the last mile of integration without the account falling into paywall territory. The pilot is live in QA but we can't hit UAT yet.

What's attached: SRE snippet showing error patterns (hydralink_sre-log-snippet.txt) and our proposed mitigation plan (hydralink-integration-plan.xlsx).

KPIs at risk: scheduled demo 9/7, initial 5k message generation target for POC.

Would appreciate if you can advise next steps / what approvals you need. If helpful I can loop in our CTO but wanted to start here.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Integrations | HydraLink
priya@hydralink.com

Attachments: hydralink_sre-log-snippet.txt (text/plain), hydralink-integration-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short runway cushion — OAuth connector is blocking our rollout

Priya — thanks for the clear summary and attachments. Sorry to hear about the vendor delay.

I can take this to approvals right away. To speed things up, two quick asks:
- Can you confirm the exact incremental tokens you expect to burn during the 2-week window (ballpark is fine).
- Is the demo on 9/7 still flexible if we push by a few days, or is that locked by your stakeholders?

Tentatively I can propose a small credit of 10,000 tokens + a 14-day trial extension; final sign-off will need Marissa and Neha's OK (looping them in). If approved we will provide a short amendment/acceptance doc for signature to avoid billing confusion.

Marissa — tagging you for CS approval and to coordinate a brief success-plan update.
Neha — tagging you for any commercial concessions that need manager sign-off.

Rafael Mendes
